sentences.text: 3 . It is submitted by learned counsel appearing for appellant that the prosecutrix was a consenting party.
She is a married lady having children.
There is delay of 11 months in lodging the FIR.
The appellant is permanent resident of District Damoh and there is no likelihood of his absconding or tempering with the prosecution evidence.
In these circumstance, he may be granted bail.
